name: watchlight-strands
summary: Watchlight governance for Strands Agents, installed once at the root: authorize every tool call (Python, MCP and agents used as tools) before it runs, open every invocation as a governed run, and attach automatically to every sub-agent, Swarm and Graph node beneath the root as an attenuated governed spawn, fail-closed. Model turns are not authorized one by one. Independent plugin, not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon Web Services.
